plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Blue Coat / Symantec Edge SWG / Broadcom ProxySG WAN optimization device. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 3417).
name: Wanopt

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the Blue Coat / Symantec Edge SWG / Broadcom ProxySG appliance since the last restart, derived from sysUpTime. Monitoring uptime helps administrators understand device stability and identify unexpected reboots.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: CPU utilization of the ProxySG appliance (BLUECOAT-SG-PROXY-MIB sgProxyCpuCoreBusyPerCent) as a 0-100 percentage averaged across CPU cores over the past minute. Sustained high CPU usage can indicate proxy, SSL inspection, or policy evaluation overload.

metrics.name: device_cpu_idle
metrics.description: CPU idle percent of the ProxySG appliance (BLUECOAT-SG-PROXY-MIB sgProxyCpuCoreIdlePerCent), averaged across CPU cores over the past minute.

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: Total memory available to the ProxySG appliance in bytes (BLUECOAT-SG-PROXY-MIB sgProxyMemAvailable).

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: Used proxy memory of the ProxySG appliance in bytes, computed as system-process usage plus object-cache usage (BLUECOAT-SG-PROXY-MIB sgProxyMemSysUsage + sgProxyMemCacheUsage).

metrics.name: device_memory_sys_usage
metrics.description: Memory used by ProxySG system and support processes in bytes (BLUECOAT-SG-PROXY-MIB sgProxyMemSysUsage).

metrics.name: device_memory_cache_usage
metrics.description: Memory used by the ProxySG object cache in bytes (BLUECOAT-SG-PROXY-MIB sgProxyMemCacheUsage).

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Proxy memory pressure of the ProxySG appliance as a 0-100 percentage of available memory (BLUECOAT-SG-PROXY-MIB sgProxyMemoryPressure). Sustained high usage can degrade caching and SSL inspection performance.
